title: Journey Cloud vs Premium
description: Journey Cloud handles cross-device sync, while Journey Premium adds AI features, unlimited media, and exports. Here is how they differ.
date: 2026-08-03
---

Journey Cloud is the sync infrastructure that mirrors your journal entries across devices. Journey Premium is the paid membership tier that adds features on top of that infrastructure, including AI prompts, speech-to-text, unlimited file attachments, and PDF exports. You can use Journey Cloud on a free tier to sync basic text entries using your own cloud drives or Journey's basic backend. Premium converts that basic sync into a broader suite by removing media caps and granting full access across web, desktop, and mobile platforms.
